Samsung to Launch New Foldable Phones and Smartwatch

Samsung is set to launch three new smartphones, including foldable models, on July 22. The event, reportedly held in London, is expected to unveil a total of seven products. Among the anticipated launches are the Galaxy Z Fold and Z Flip, alongside a potential new version of the Galaxy Watch Ultra.
